status: pre-registered before any 2021-22, 2022-23 or 2023-24 line was scored, any calibration map was fit on them, or any forward (2026-11-19+) outcome was opened
hypothesis: The frozen baseline's reliability curve is not log-linear: observed More hit rates plateau while stated confidence keeps rising, and Less forecasts are close to calibrated. A per-stat, shrinkage-regularized monotone (isotonic) map of the baseline's binary P(more), fit on one earlier season, improves probability quality on a later untouched season, reduces high-confidence overconfidence, and does more than the already-tested log-odds intercept/slope recalibration.

relatedButDistinct.sports:overall-recalibration: tested (lab-sports-ablation-v1-recalibration, props-temperature-v2): log-odds intercept/slope or temperature. Linear in log-odds, cannot plateau. Re-fit here as a comparator only.
relatedButDistinct.sports:side-asymmetric-calibration: tested (lab-sports-challengers-v2-side-asym): separate linear slopes for positive/negative log-odds. Still linear on each side.
relatedButDistinct.sports:minutes-uncertainty-shrinkage: tested: log-odds shrinkage by minutes CV and games of history.
relatedButDistinct.sports:line-gap-shrinkage: tested (props-gap-shrink-v1, challengers-v2 line_gap): shrinkage by model-vs-line gap.
relatedButDistinct.minutes-spread lead from PR #191: explored on the inspected 2025-26 season while choosing this hypothesis: Brier 0.23946 -> 0.23885, More 0.90+ gap unchanged at 0.271. Not pursued.

challenger.input: baseline binary non-tie P(more) q = pMore / (pMore + pLess) and the stat
challenger.pooledMap: per bin, target (hits + 100 x q_mean) / (n + 100): shrunk toward the identity with 100 pseudo-lines; weighted pool-adjacent-violators with weights n + 100
challenger.perStatMap: per stat and bin, target (hits + 100 x pooledMap(q_mean)) / (n + 100); weighted PAV with weights n + 100
challenger.knots: each bin's mean q (bin midpoint when empty); piecewise-linear between knots, flat outside the outer knots
challenger.fixedConstants: kappa 100, 20 bins and the clamp are fixed here and never tuned

comparatorTested.rule: per stat, logistic regression of the outcome on [1, logit(q)] (Newton, 50 iterations, q clamped to [1e-6, 1-1e-6]), fit on the same training lines. Reported, and used in requirement R7 only.

sources.license: CC BY 4.0, SportsDataverse ESPN NBA player box scores

trainingPrior.role: 2021-22: league rates, player priors and NB dispersion for scoring the training season; never scored

training.role: 2022-23: baseline scored, calibration maps fit; also the prior season for the holdout

holdout.role: 2023-24: UNTOUCHED as a scored season. Previously used only as prior-season input (league rates, player priors, an NB dispersion moment) by the 2024-25 backtest; no probability, calibration or hit rate on its games was ever computed or reported

trainingPrior.role: 2024-25 priors for scoring the forward training season (as in PR #191)

training.role: 2025-26: calibration maps for the forward arm; dispersion through 2025-12-31 (as in PR #191)

evaluation.sha256: recorded at each forward run (live file grows)
evaluation.window: games starting at or after 2026-11-19T12:00:00Z; every earlier 2026-27 game was inspected by PRs #125, #164 and #191
evaluation.baseline: src/data/props/model_v1.json exactly, as the live worker scores

pipeline.retrospective: the existing backtest design (scripts/props-model-fit.ts backtest): a season is scored walk-forward with league rates and player priors from the previous season, and NB dispersion from the previous season's own walk-forward with league-rate priors. Training = 2022-23 scored from 2021-22; holdout = 2023-24 scored from 2022-23. Identical procedure, shifted one season. The calibrator is fit only on training-season lines.
pipeline.forward: training = 2025-26 scored with 2024-25 priors and dispersion through 2025-12-31 (PR #191 training pipeline); evaluation = production artifact on 2026-27 games in the forward window.
pipeline.lines: proxy lines floor(median of last 10 played) + 0.5 from earlier games only (all existing props studies). Half-point lines cannot push.
pipeline.unit: one line per played player-game and stat (points, rebounds, assists) the baseline scores; DNPs are not scored (platforms void them)

outcome: y = 1 if the stat is above the line, 0 if below; an exact tie (only possible on integer lines) is a push and is excluded from binary scoring. No multiclass/tie-aware Brier is computed or compared.

metrics.ece: 10 equal-width bins on P(more), weighted |mean P - observed more rate|
metrics.reliability: same 10 bins: n, mean predicted, observed
metrics.confidenceBands: decision confidence max(P,1-P) bands 0.50-0.60, 0.60-0.70, 0.70-0.80, 0.80-0.90, 0.90+ by direction (More if P>=0.5), each model by its own forecasts: n, mean confidence, hit rate, gap
metrics.highConfidenceFixedSet: lines where the BASELINE decision confidence >= 0.70 (and separately >= 0.80, >= 0.90 when n >= 200): Brier of each model on that fixed line set
metrics.murphy: Brier = reliability - resolution + uncertainty over the 20 calibration bins
metrics.auc: Mann-Whitney AUC of P(more) for outcome more

uncertainty.method: paired bootstrap resampling whole games (ESPN game id); per game, all lines and all stats move together

requirements.R0_data: holdout >= 20,000 lines and >= 500 games; training >= 2,000 lines per stat. Otherwise INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE.
requirements.R4_highConfidence: on the fixed set of lines with baseline confidence >= 0.70: challenger - baseline Brier upper95 < 0
requirements.R5_noSubgroupHarm: for More and Less (baseline direction) and for each stat: challenger - baseline Brier lower95 <= 0
requirements.R6_noExcessCompression: challenger resolution >= 0.80 x baseline resolution AND challenger AUC >= baseline AUC - 0.002 AND challenger SD of P(more) >= 0.50 x baseline SD

verdict.FAILS: challenger - baseline Brier lower95 > 0, or log loss lower95 > 0 (credibly worse than the frozen baseline)
verdict.note: The verdict is decided by the untouched 2023-24 holdout only. QUALIFIES_FOR_FORWARD_TEST never promotes: it only admits the frozen forward-arm calibrator to prospective evaluation. Everything else is descriptive.

forwardEvaluation.calibrator: fit once on 2025-26 (forward pipeline), committed before any forward outcome is opened, then frozen
forwardEvaluation.minimum: >= 150 games and >= 5,000 lines in the forward window; below that the forward status is INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE
forwardEvaluation.rule: the same R1 to R6 against the production artifact; R7 against single-slope recal fit on the same 2025-26 lines
forwardEvaluation.realLines: graded real platform lines from the props ledger are scored by Codex's existing paired evaluation (500 lines, 14 dates, 50 games review gate) and are never mixed with proxy lines

descriptive: the exploratory 2025-26 diagnostics that motivated this hypothesis (inspected season)
notUsed: any game at or after the predicted game
